definitions.explanation: Speaking very little by nature. Describes a person who does not talk much, not because they are shy or upset, but as a personality trait.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寡黙|かもく}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: My father is a taciturn person.

examples.japanese: {寡黙|かもく}な⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{黙々|もくもく}→黙々：14712_mokumoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A taciturn craftsman is working silently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寡黙|かもく}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦いざ→いざ：28114_iza⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{頼|たよ}りになる→頼りになる：20294_tayorininaru⟧。
examples.english: He is quiet, but you can count on him when it matters.

notes:
USAGE:
{寡黙|かもく} is typically used as a positive or neutral description. It often conveys a sense of quiet dignity or reliability, especially when describing men or craftsmen. In Japanese culture, being {寡黙|かもく} is sometimes admired as a sign of strength or depth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寡黙|かもく}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ — a taciturn person
- {寡黙|かもく}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ — a quiet personality
- {寡黙|かもく}な⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧ — a man of few words

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{無口|むくち}→無口：06644_mukuchi⟧ also means quiet or not talkative and is more common in everyday conversation. {寡黙|かもく} has a more literary or respectful nuance. Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧ (subject, course), which has a completely different meaning.
